title: Sea-facing residence, Worli
description: A family of four moved from a low-rise in Prabhadevi into a 4,200 sq ft apartment with a straight view of the sea. The brief was to keep the view and quieten everything else. We reworked the plan to put the living and dining rooms along the west face, wrapped the service side in full-height teak joinery, and used a single stone across the kitchen and bar so the eye never stops. Every piece of joinery was made at our Vasai works and dry-fitted before it reached site.

title: The Marlowe boutique hotel
description: Thirty-eight keys, a lobby and an all-day dining room, delivered floor by floor while the hotel stayed open on the floors below. The palette holds to three materials — dark stained ash, unpolished Kota stone and raw linen — so that rooms refurbished a year apart still read as one hotel. Our team worked nights for the public areas and handed each floor back with its own snag sign-off.

title: Ardent Systems headquarters
description: A software company of three hundred people wanted fewer desks and more rooms people would actually book. We planned the floor around eleven enclosed rooms of varying size, wrapped the core in acoustic slatted timber, and used the reception stone as the only hard surface on the floor. Delivered in nineteen weeks against a twenty-two week programme.

title: Weekend villa, Alibaug
scope: Turnkey villa interior and landscape joinery
description: A weekend house that had to survive salt air and long empty weeks. Terrazzo underfoot throughout, marine-grade hardware on every external door, and furniture that can be covered and left. The dining room was planned around a single round table so that eighteen people can sit down without the room being rearranged.

title: Turner Road apartment
description: A 1970s apartment with good bones and bad services. We stripped it back, moved one wall, and rebuilt the flat around a long teak spine that carries storage, seating and the media wall in one line. The owners stayed in the building throughout, so work was scheduled around a strict noise window.

title: Sona all-day restaurant
description: A hundred and ten covers in a mill compound shell, built in fourteen weeks to hit a fixed opening date. Deep navy panelling, cream banquettes and warm glass pendants give the room its evening character; daylight from the north face keeps it usable at lunch. Acoustic treatment sits behind the panelling so the room stays conversational when full.

title: Garden duplex, Koramangala
description: A duplex with a small garden the owners wanted to see from the kitchen. We moved the kitchen to the garden face, built it around a fluted island, and kept the upper floor deliberately plain so the ground floor carries the character. The joinery is a single pale finish used at four different scales.

title: Penthouse, Juhu
description: A duplex penthouse being rebuilt around a new internal stair. Joinery is in production at Vasai, stone has been selected and slabbed, and the home cinema is being specified with Fabluxe Home Solutions. Handover is scheduled for the fourth quarter.

title: Vantage campus, phase two
scope: Two floors of workplace, live campus
description: The second phase of a workplace campus, delivered while the first phase stays occupied. Two floors of open workspace, focus rooms and a staff café, planned to the same detail set as phase one so the two are indistinguishable at handover.

title: Ostro café and bakery
description: A small footprint with a long counter and a first-floor terrace. Everything is being built to be cleaned hard: stone counters, powder-coated steel and a single sealed floor from door to terrace. On site now, opening in the spring.

title: Casa Ferra suites
description: Fourteen suites in a restored Portuguese-era building, where every new element is reversible and nothing is fixed into the original plasterwork. Furniture is being made in Vasai and shipped down in two batches to keep the site clear.

title: Lark Residences show home
scope: Developer show home and sales lounge
description: A show home for a developer selling four hundred apartments off-plan. Every finish had to be available in volume and hold up to a thousand visitors a month. Built in eight weeks, and still in use three years later with only one repaint.
